notes: NON-CANONICAL and PROVISIONAL: pilot, gate only; self-supply only; never pooled with eval 6 D1. This arm has never run live (docs/evals/eval6.md, D3 section).
No model default: the runner refuses to launch without --model.

instances = the design's eight worlds w1-w7, w9 (v7 Appendix E.2); w10-w12 are allowed with --instances. reps 5 = the gate's design (agree-5 needs five reports per world; the report labels a world with fewer agree-k).
max_turns 60: set generously so that it is not the binding constraint.
wall_clock_s 2400: twice the lab harness's 1200 s inner timeout.
usd_rail null: no per-attempt USD rail is set on D3; cap the run with --max-total-usd.
Attrition: rails are scored outcomes in the core and never retried; the D3 report counts a rail hit or a missing figure as a missing report, never a zero, and prints n per world.

isolation container: the arm needs bash; exact --tools, per-attempt sandbox deletion and a container-private TMPDIR keep each session to its own sandbox and tool set (docs/instrument-changes/eval6.md D3-06).
